execution.order: Single seeded32 document/repeat sequence shared by all38 configs and both contexts. Independently seeded frozen owner-block order per context. Persist full schedule before first generation
execution.private_owner: At most one live owner. Each fresh owner: constructor, old271 cold prime, all32 warm requests in fixed order, synchronize and close. No concurrent owner memory/Graph pools
execution.primary_clock: Full unprofiled generate outer including handoff,input preparation,prefill,reset,all legal lazy captures,decode,cleanup. Common model loading/shared wrapper preparation excluded identically
execution.captures: No free pre-capture, test-aware warmup, borrowing quality-stage Graphs or capture-free filtering. Start Graph owner with zero captures; bill every legal late capture
execution.secondary_clocks: Constructor+prime cold and constructor+prime+32warm+close accounted active-service sums separately; not production wall throughput
execution.drift: Owner blocks, not interleaved requests: disclose thermal/clock drift limitation. Read-only GPU diagnostics outside primary request clock; never change clocks/power or discard slow blocks
execution.failure: Save raw first then check. Preserve partial/failed roots, no resume/restart/delete/fallback or silent candidate omission

correctness.immutability: Bind all imported runtime,27 upstream tree sources, real Flash extension, models, data, tokenizer, dtype, physical GPU, staged manifest; recheck before completion
